title: Skies Of Blue: Remake
description:
Skies Of Blue: Remake is a first-person puzzle-platformer where you work your way through a series of different levels utilizing various key items, including bombs, keys and your pistol, along with fresh and interesting mechanics that change as you progress.

Progressive MechanicsAs you progress, new mechanics are added to constantly test you and push your puzzle-solving skills further. That means more ways to play and more ways to fight.

Bosses
Every 20 levels, a powerful boss from the deep depths of the world will cross paths with you and prevent you from progressing further. Take them on and prove your strength and WIN.

ExtrasAlong with the main gameplay, hidden collectables are hidden around the game, find them all and unlock special abilities to make the gameplay different. Getting bored with playing pre-built levels? The game also contains a custom level builder, so you can make your own levels and show them off to your friends!

There are lots of levels to chose from, with more being added in coming updates.
